decisions.sourceDescription: 《家和萬事驚》首映活動；Commons 中文圖說與 Wikidata Q5094266 指向張達明

stageReview.eyes: pass: two eyes and eyebrows clear, no nose tip or mouth
stageReview.nose: pass: eyes and complete nose revealed, mouth/teeth hidden
stageReview.mouth: pass: eyes, nose and teeth/mouth visible; full chin not yet revealed
stageReview.chin: pass: lower chin/jaw visible; scarf remains below face
stageReview.full: pass: single recognizable frontal face, both eyes, nose, mouth and chin visible, no glasses, microphone, watermark, second face or obtrusive object

decisions.identityEvidence: Wikidata Q5094266 P18 and Commons photo caption identify Hong Kong actor 張達明 at 2019 premiere; source photo visually matches event imagery, not unrelated same-name person.
decisions.rightsEvidence: Commons page names am730 as author and 2019 original YouTube video; independent reviewer GRuban confirmed CC BY 3.0 on 2020-07-24. Licence allows cropped redistribution with attribution and modification notice; original and crop hashes retained.
decisions.recognitionEvidence: Actual 600x720 JPEG and all five PNG stages were displayed as a six-panel montage from GitHub Actions #41170980227, manually inspected: eyes→nose→mouth→chin→full sequence is correct, face clear and recognizable.
decisions.reason: Automated YuNet initially failed frontal face detection; immutable original SHA verified by GitHub Actions #41170672128 and manually cropped from original pixels. Five-stage montage reviewed from actual GitHub-rendered PNGs, not merely inferred from metadata. Approved only for review-branch integration pending Mobile QA, work hints QA, rights gate, Pages build/live JSON and public image SHA checks.
